description: The bar chart illustrates the number of sentences (in thousands) associated with different text categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled “Categories,” shown as rotated tick labels in the order: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, and Science; no explicit sorting is indicated. The vertical axis is labeled “Sentences (K)” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 200, 400, 600, and 800 (range extending to just above 900). Each category is represented by a single solid light-red/pink bar with a blue numeric value label above it: Administrative is about 525K, Religion about 50K, Non-fiction about 190K, Fiction about 35K, Law about 23K, News about 902K, and Science about 110K. There is no legend, no stacking or grouping beyond one bar per category, and no special highlighting other than the blue value annotations.
